subject: Two papers: one mentioning Stan and one using it

messages.author: 20758fda448fdbda
messages.subject: Two papers: one mentioning Stan and one using it
parts:
Finally, finally, my papers have been published.

This first one mentions Stan in passing as being able to address highly correlated hyperparameters, but doesn't use it. Forgive me, the original draft was written in 2012. Yes, it's been through the wringer!
  • Adler, Avraham. 2015. A Survey of Approaches to a Changepoint Problem in an Actuarial Context.Variance 9(1):64–100. http://www.variancejournal.org/issues/?fa=article&abstrID=7179
This one uses Stan (being written predominantly in 2014). 
  • Adler, Avraham. 2015. Estimating the Parameter Risk of a Loss Ratio Distribution—Revisited. Variance 9(1):114–139. http://www.variancejournal.org/issues/?fa=article&abstrID=7181


As always, Thank you, Stan team, for all your support and help!


Avi
